LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Writing mechanics (spelling) • Paragraph
Topic 3.3: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing 3.1 Guided Writing (1 lesson) • Writing mechanics (spelling) • Paragraph in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: Why is clarity important in written communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. look at the displayed flashcards on various facilities found in the school (e.g. 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 教室 jiàoshì, 体育馆 tǐyùguǎn, 操场 cāochǎng, 办公室 bàngōngshì, 教师休息室 jiàoshī xiūxíshì) and practise writing them,

2. listen to a short passage then write down the names of the school facilities mentioned,

3. work together to match the given pictures to the corresponding sentences on school facilities (e.g. 这是图书馆 Zhè shì túshū guǎn, 这是教室 zhè shì jiàoshì),

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. look at the displayed flashcards on various facilities found in the school (e.g. 图书馆 túshūguǎn, 教室 jiàoshì, 体育馆 tǐyùguǎn, 操场 cāochǎng, 办公室 bàngōngshì, 教师休息室 jiàoshī xiūxíshì) and practise writing them,
2. listen to a short passage then write down the names of the school facilities mentioned,
3. work together to match the given pictures to the corresponding sentences on school facilities (e.g. 这是图书馆 Zhè shì túshū guǎn, 这是教室 zhè shì jiàoshì),

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and Collaboration: The learner writes fluently and in an organised manner short paragraphs on facilities found

in the school using the given words.

Values:
Responsibility: The learner engages in assigned roles and duties when they work collaboratively to match the given pictures to

the corresponding sentences.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental awareness: The learner becomes aware of their environment and surroundings as they acknowledge the different

school facilities, and how that informs their whereabouts at any given time.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner can relate the concept of giving locations and directions in their surroundings to their learning in Social Studies.
